name: Steadfast
description: This Pokemon becomes even more dependable when adversity strikes.
effect: The first time this Pokemon is affected by Flinch, Increase its Base Dexterity by 1. After activating this ability, reduce any Chance Dice to Flinch the User by 1 for the rest of combat. Guaranteed Flinches instead become 5 Chance Dice to activate (this reduction stacks with the Flinch Rules when applicable).
